title.narrative: China Economic Transformation and Institutional Capacity Building

description.narrative: Project Development Objectives are to (i) inform China's policy making and (ii) strengthen capacity to implement priority reform areas articulated in China's Five-Year Plans and other development programs.

The development objectives of the Economic Transformation and Institutional Capacity Building Project for China are to: (i) inform China's policy making; and (ii) strengthen capacity to implement priority reform areas articulated in China's five-year plans and other development programs. The project comprises of two components. The first component, analytical outputs include sectoral research, technical studies, and topical reports. The following six thematic areas will be priorities anticipated in China's development: (1) fiscal and financial reform; (2) economic restructuring; (3) rural and urban integration; (4) green economy; (5) reform of the national innovation system; and (6) public service delivery (education, healthcare, and social welfare). The second component, implementation support, project management, and capacity building will support activities including: (i) various types of training and knowledge sharing (local and abroad); (ii) overseas study in technical areas and scholarships for professional development of senior officials in foreign universities and institutes; (iii) secondment programs to international organizations; (iv) institution building (for example, workshops, seminars, and courses); (v) information platforms and information systems management; and (vi) implementation support at the central and also subproject levels (for example, financial management, budget oversight and disbursement, record keeping, procurement, monitoring and evaluation).
